subject: code for identifying work days and non work days

messages.author: 8456d3d3c4afb88e
messages.subject: code for identifying work days and non work days
parts:
Hi all,

Could you please let me know if there is code available for separating data into work days or non work days within GGIR?

many thanks
Aron

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] code for identifying work days and non work days
parts:
In the person level output GGIR splits the week in weekend- and in weekdays. If you prefer to aggregate data in a different way, e.g. based on a diary of when people worked or based on a different definition of "weekend", then I would advise to use the day summary output and aggregate it yourself. Just add a column of when people worked and then most statistical packages should offer some kind of aggregation option.
Best,
Vincent
